# B"H — OAuth tools (`/api/oauth/tools/`)

Small shared helpers for the OAuth routes.

- `bodyParser.js` — Parse request bodies.
- `requestData.js` — Extract request data.
- `respond.js` — Response helpers.
- `html.js` — HTML escaping/building.
- `urls.js` — URL builders.
